tide-tables shows tide times for UK beaches on a phone-sized web page.
In tide-tables, tide predictions come from the Admiralty UK Tidal API, not NOAA, because NOAA has no UK stations.
In tide-tables, every time is stored in UTC and converted to Europe/London only for display.
In tide-tables, API responses are cached for 6 hours in SQLite to stay under the free tier's 10,000 calls a month.
The user plans to add surf height forecasts to tide-tables after the tide pages ship.
